notes: Event types 0/2/3/4/10/12 are high-confidence; 1/8/9 medium; 6/7/11 low.
Fleet damage-taken total (type 2) matches extra_info_map['103'] when present.
Type 1 encodes weapon as moduleId*100+suffix (system hit slot); not a ship_system id.
Type 10 = Sympathetic Detonation (UI parentheses on Damage Received).
Aircraft/UAV parentCarrierId is instance rawRow[4]; UAVs roll onto parents, fighters/corvettes stay distinct (Op Stats hangar breakout).
Reinforce-command hulls: part1 rawRow[6] != 0 (shared group id; typically 5 capitals).
Maintenance on capitals ≈ HP recovery received by hull + child UAVs (type 4).
Tree path is UI coordinates, not enhance_id list — enhanceRaw is authoritative.
Status Apply/Receive comes from protocol 2407 cache (not FlagInfo); open Status tab before capture.
Blueprint version / ADV badge comes from ShipInfo on ReportViewData (status_analysis.shipMeta).
systemDestroyLog.weapon_id is a ship_system id (Front/Back Row Command System, etc.).
